Our 4 x 110 team consisted of Underwood, Holtum, Bartlett and Mullen, while our 4 x 440 team was Kennedy, Alan Bishop, Ken. Cuff and Fox. Needless to say we did not score any points in these races, but we did manage to win the 4 x 1 mile event.
The Juniors repeated their score in the 880 yds. but in the Senior event the Herne Hill men were too strong for our two, Dooley and Fox, and so went ahead on points.

In the relay our team of Gordon, Fox, Jones and Leroy only missed the ground record by one fifth of a second. As our President said afterwards when giving our thanks for a first class supper, "we were few in number but ability and keenness were there".
